title: Successful Login with Valid Credentials
description: Verify that a registered user can log into the system with valid email and password.
steps: Enter valid email and valid password
expected_result: User is authenticated successfully and redirected to dashboard.

title: Account Lockout on 5 Invalid Login Attempts
description: Verify that account is locked after 5 consecutive incorrect password entries.
steps: Enter registered email and wrong password 5 times in a row
expected_result: Account is locked and an error message is displayed.

title: User Login Success Scenario
description: Verify customer login with valid credentials.
steps: Provide user email and correct password
expected_result: Customer logs in successfully to user dashboard.

title: Update Profile Details
description: Verify user can update profile details such as name and phone number.
steps: Update phone number and click Save
expected_result: Profile details updated successfully and confirmation prompt appears.

title: Password Reset via Email Link
description: Verify customer receives password reset link on registered email.
expected_result: Password reset email link sent to inbox.
